rationale: The plan fits ~ batch + condition with control as explicit reference, correctly keeps batch as a covariate rather than pre-adjusting counts (ComBat-seq explicitly excluded from the test path), and cross-checks with edgeR QL on the identical design/filter, treating the intersection (not union) as high-confidence. QC precedes testing with blind VST PCA and distance heatmap colored by both condition and batch, with an explicit outlier/library-size policy that flags but does not remove. The filter (>=10 counts in >=6 samples, smallest group size) is minimal and justified. Normalization is internal (DESeq2 size factors, edgeR TMM) with raw counts only entering the model. BH at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering and apeglm shrinkage are correctly specified, with unshrunken/shrunken values both reported. Enrichment is well-justified (preranked GSEA on Wald stat, tested-gene universe, named Hallmark/Reactome collections with version, 15-500 size window, seeded, ORA correctly withheld if <50 sig genes). The final report is comprehensive, naming methods, versions, design, thresholds, gene counts, and design caveats including the batch effect and NA padj causes.
